result.summary: The page appears to be a well-structured food delivery app home screen with no significant visual defects. Only a minor styling inconsistency was noted.

issues.description: The heart (favorite) icon on the Tokumaru Ramen Bar card has a white/transparent background while the heart icon on the pizza card below has a dark circular background, creating visual inconsistency between similar interactive elements.
issues.suggestion: Standardize the favorite icon background style across all restaurant cards for a consistent look.
